generationRecords.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT the input sprite sheet only. Do not invent new people, poses or frame layouts. Retain eight exact figures, four columns NE SE SW NW, two gait frames, same camera and stance. Change ONLY clothes and headwear to: dusty purple grey practical long kirtle, ochre short headwrap crossing at forehead tied behind head, no apron, narrow red livery cuff patch. Southern England 1300-1450 hand-painted small game walker style, muted historically available dyes. Keep face, hands, feet positions and silhouettes exactly in place; do not change hem boundary, head height or width. No tools/props. Transparent background. Preserve the input 2:1 sheet with each cell in exactly its original position. No grid, no labels, no shadow, no extra characters.
